create_MLP: create a feed-forward MLP with configurable input, hidden, output dimensions and layer count
build_MLP_forward: build an MLP forward pass that applies linear layers with ReLU activations
test_MLP: test the MLP class by instantiating with specific dimensions and running a forward pass
refactor_MLP_layers: refactor the MLP to add dropout or batch normalization between linear layers
review_MLP_init: review the MLP __init__ to understand how linear layers are constructed from dimension parameters
